stepNotes.1: Confirmed exactly 3 files in scope; traced both mount sites in App.tsx (line 214 embedded-only via ocPanel query param, line 965 main) and verified they are mutually exclusive, so no real double-mount.
stepNotes.2: Public surface is 7 dedup exports + 1 React.FC; side effects are confined to the component, matching the module header contract at axCodeUpdateDedup.ts:1-11.
stepNotes.3: Cancellation is correct: cancelled flag set on teardown (AxCodeUpdateToast.tsx:203) and checked post-await (:172); all setTimeout handles accumulated in timeoutIds and cleared together (:204), so no retry fires after unmount.
stepNotes.4: shouldShowAxCodeUpdateToast ordering (empty -> seen -> dismissed) is right; both server coercions trim and the dismiss handler stores the already-trimmed version, so literal equality at axCodeUpdateDedup.ts:33 is safe across whitespace variants.
stepNotes.5: Retries use CHECK_RETRY_DELAYS_MS=[10000,60000] and stop cleanly when attempt index exceeds the array (:184-185); JSON-parse guards at :66 and :171 swallow to null; noted no AbortController/timeout on either fetch as a low-severity robustness gap.
stepNotes.6: Pure/effect split is the unit's main strength — dedup module is import-free and side-effect-free, which is what makes the 28-case suite possible; AxCodeUpgradeStatusLike is a correctly permissive mirror of untrusted server JSON.
stepNotes.7: Timing values and toast/storage IDs are all named module-level constants (:17-22); getSafeStorage degrades to an in-memory Storage when window.localStorage is absent or throws, so dismiss persistence works in jsdom/non-browser contexts.
stepNotes.8: Pure helpers are exhaustively covered (28 tests across all four functions), but the 210-line component effect — retry schedule, unmount cancellation, event wiring, upgrade POST branches, incompatible-version dedup — has zero component tests; this is the largest quality lift.
stepNotes.9: No Critical or High findings; findings/ is empty and this pass added none, so no reverify gate triggers; two non-blocking follow-ups recorded (component test coverage + AbortController on the upgrade POST) for the module owner.
